cat > /opt/inventory-api/app.py <<'PYEOF'
import json
import sqlite3
import threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/inventory-api/inventory.db"
LOCK = threading.Lock()

def init_db():
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    con.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, qty INTEGER NOT NULL)")
    cur = con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items")
    if cur.fetchone()[0] == 0:
        con.execute("INSERT INTO items (name, qty) VALUES ('widget', 100)")
        con.execute("INSERT INTO items (name, qty) VALUES ('gadget', 50)")
    con.commit()
    con.close()

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _json(self, code, payload):
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            self._json(200, {"status": "ok"})
            return
        if self.path == "/inventory":
            with LOCK:
                con = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
                rows = con.execute("SELECT id, name, qty FROM items").fetchall()
                con.close()
            self._json(200, [{"id": r[0], "name": r[1], "qty": r[2]} for r in rows])
            return
        self._json(404, {"error": "not found"})

    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path == "/inventory":
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
            data = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length) or b"{}")
            name = data.get("name")
            qty = data.get("qty")
            if not name or qty is None:
                self._json(400, {"error": "name and qty required"})
                return
            with LOCK:
                con = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
                con.execute("INSERT INTO items (name, qty) VALUES (?, ?)", (name, qty))
                con.commit()
                new_id = con.execute("SELECT last_insert_rowid()").fetchone()[0]
                con.close()
            self._json(201, {"id": new_id, "name": name, "qty": qty})
            return
        self._json(404, {"error": "not found"})

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    init_db()
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()
